Do not make up or assume the current time."}, {"modality": "REQUIRE", "target": "search knowledge base to find tools that can be given to user", "condition": "user wants to perform an action", "exception": null, "temporal": null, "participants": [], "quote": "You must search the knowledge base to find tools that you can give. Do not invent or guess user discoverable tools"}, {"modality": "REQUIRE", "target": "use give_discoverable_user_tool() function to give tools to user", "condition": "user wants to perform an action", "exception": null, "temporal": null, "participants": [], "quote": "When to give user discoverable tools: - Only give a tool when the user would like to perform an action, and the knowledge base explicitly has a tool that allows the user to perform this action (e.g., "to do X, have the user call tool_name(args)")"}, {"modality": "REQUIRE", "target": "unlock agent discoverable tools before using them", "condition": "knowledge base explicitly mentions agent discoverable tools", "exception": null, "temporal": null, "participants": [], "quote": "When to use agent discoverable tools: - Only unlock a tool when the knowledge base explicitly mentions it (e.g., "use tool_name to perform X"), and do not unlock tools you do not plan to use."}, {"modality": "REQUIRE", "target": "call unlock_discoverable_agent_tool() function to unlock agent discoverable tools", "condition": "agent discoverable tools are unlocked", "exception": null, "temporal": null, "participants": [], "quote": "How to use agent discoverable tools: 1. First, unlock the tool using unlock_discoverable_agent_tool(agent_tool_name) with the exact tool name from the knowledge base:"}, {"modality": "REQUIRE", "target": "call call_discoverable_agent_tool() function to use agent discoverable tools", "condition": "agent discoverable tools are unlocked", "exception": null, "temporal": null, "participants": [], "quote": "2. Then, call the tool using call_discoverable_agent_tool(agent_tool_name, arguments) with the required arguments"}, {"modality": "REQUIRE", "target": "ask user if they want to be transferred to human agent", "condition": "issue cannot be resolved or is outside capabilities", "exception": null, "temporal": null, "participants": [], "quote": "Generally, if the issue cannot be resolved or is outside your capabilities, ask the user whether they would like to be transferred to a human agent."}, {"modality": "REQUIRE", "target": "invoke transfer_to_human_agents tool after asking user", "condition": "user agrees to be transferred", "exception": null, "temporal": null, "participants": [], "quote": "If they do, invoke the appropriate transfer_to_human_agents tool."}, {"modality": "REQUIRE", "target": "inform user that you can help them before transferring", "condition": "user wants to be transferred", "exception": null, "temporal": null, "participants": [], "quote": "If an issue falls within your capabilities and the user still wants to be transferred to a human agent, kindly inform the user that you can help them, and try to help them first."}, {"modality": "REQUIRE", "target": "ask user if they want to be transferred after 3 attempts", "condition": "user wants to be transferred after 3 attempts", "exception": null, "temporal": null, "participants": [], "quote": "If the user asks for a human agent 4 times, then you may invoke the transfer_to_human_agents tool."}, {"modality": "FORBID", "target": "make up policies, information or actions", "condition": "all instructions will be found here or in the knowledge base", "exception": null, "temporal": null, "participants": [], "quote": "Do not make up policies, information or actions that you can take on behalf of the user.
